gcp.nat.data_processed.note: Public NAT: data processed by the gateway, inbound and outbound (per GiB). The same in every region. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.nat.gateway_hour_capped.note: Public NAT gateway uptime serving more than 32 VM instances: the hourly charge stops growing here. By hand from https://cloud.google.com/nat/pricing: the Billing Catalog has one gateway uptime SKU (Networking Cloud Nat Gateway Uptime, $0.0014 a VM-hour, one tier) and no SKU or tier for the $0.044 cap, so sync cannot check it.

gcp.nat.ip_hour.note: Each static or ephemeral external IP address a Public NAT gateway uses, an hour. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.nat.private.data_processed.note: Private NAT: data processed by the gateway, inbound and outbound (per GiB). Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.nat.private.gateway_hour.note: Private NAT gateway uptime. Synced from the Billing Catalog.

gcp.nat.vm_hour.note: Public NAT gateway uptime: this much an hour for each VM instance that gets a NAT assignment, up to 32 (the SKU's hour is a VM-hour). The same in every region. Synced from the Billing Catalog.
